project.name: Codepot
project.tagline: Portable software intent, deterministic derivation, and reusable generation packs.
project.description: Codepot explores a language-neutral semantic layer for describing software intent and deriving target-specific artifacts through explicit, deterministic packs. Dryv is the active implementation family.

stages.title: Active Dryv implementation
stages.summary: The canonical Runtime IR, authoring frontend, CLI, template engine, and target adapters under active development.

stages.title: Active applications
stages.summary: The public website and dedicated documentation application boundary.

stages.title: Frozen earlier packages
stages.summary: Retained for existing users and historical comparison, but not active development targets.

products.name: dryv
products.description: Canonical Runtime IR, validation, transport, planning, inspection, plugins, and ownership-safe generation orchestration.
products.role: Own canonical software meaning and deterministic derivation contracts.

products.name: dryv-author
products.description: Typed Python authoring helpers that compile software meaning into canonical Dryv Runtime IR.
products.role: Provide a clean authoring frontend without owning generation or serialization.

products.name: dryv-cli
products.description: A thin terminal frontend over public Dryv runtime operations.
products.role: Present planning, generation, inspection, and diagnostics without duplicating domain logic.

products.name: dryv-template-jinja
products.description: Bounded and sandboxed Jinja rendering through Dryv's public template-engine contract.
products.role: Render pack templates without redefining semantic meaning.

products.name: dryv-language-typescript
products.description: TypeScript naming, module, path, suffix, keyword, and validation facts.
products.role: Provide target facts while templates retain ownership of emitted syntax.

products.name: dryv-language-dart
products.description: Dart naming, module, package, path, keyword, and validation facts.
products.role: Provide target facts while templates retain ownership of emitted syntax.

products.name: Codepot site
products.description: The public website and current public documentation renderer.
products.role: Present Codepot and compile selected Markdown from the canonical .docs tree.

products.name: Codepot documentation app
products.description: The dedicated application boundary for documentation rendering and validation.
products.role: Eventually own documentation application behavior without owning Markdown source.

products.name: codepot-openapi
products.description: Earlier TypeScript-first OpenAPI authoring package retained for compatibility and historical comparison.
products.role: Historical predecessor; not an active architecture target.

products.name: codepotg
products.description: Earlier OpenAPI-oriented Python generator retained for compatibility and historical comparison.
products.role: Historical predecessor; not an active architecture target.

products.name: codepotx
products.description: Earlier JavaScript runtime and generation-system exploration.
products.role: Historical predecessor; not an active architecture target.

products.name: codepotx-cli
products.role: Historical predecessor; not an active architecture target.
